context_guard.estimate: one token per serialized UTF-8 byte plus framing; conservative estimate, not tokenization

execution_gate: Original typed contracts + owned candidate/source/task binding + formal authorization + applicability + actual remaining total/subbudgets + original safety/unknown-outcome guards. No subjective scientific score prerequisite.
soft_evaluation: After execution, assess interpretation scope, novelty and use of actual feedback. Unsupported inferences remain hypotheses; never receive certificate or acceptance credit.
completion: At least one genuinely new legal scientific action, real feedback delivered, Agent decision after feedback; at most two numerical actions then public read/cite STOP or original exact SELECT on full pass. Full Cold-start and C5 excluded.
data_scope: Only this prepared Study necessary frozen task, engineering syntax, candidate/control, permitted historical failed evidence and related Agent/Reporter dialogue. No credentials, unrelated files or hidden historical successful answer.
scientific_choice: Main research Agent chooses and submits method/design/control. Supervisor never supplies or runs science on its behalf.
